# China Highlights

> > China Highlights is a comprehensive travel planning platform specializing in customized tours across China's major destinations including Beijing, Xi'an, Guilin, Zhangjiajie, Shanghai, and Chengdu.

The site offers detailed tour packages ranging from cultural heritage experiences to adventure travel, along with practical travel guides covering weather, accommodations, and cultural insights. China Highlights focuses on helping first-time visitors and experienced travelers explore China's diverse landscapes, ethnic minority villages, and iconic landmarks like the Forbidden City, Longji Terraced Fields, and Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon Glass Bridge.

## Key Topics

- China tour packages
- Beijing and Forbidden City
- Xi'an and Terracotta Warriors
- Guilin and Yangshuo landscapes
- Zhangjiajie National Forest Park
- Longji Terraced Fields
- Shanghai cultural tours
- Chengdu and pandas
- Ethnic minority villages
- Glass Bridge adventures
- First-time visitor itineraries
- Chinese cultural heritage
- Adventure and hiking tours
- Beach holidays in Sanya
- Yunnan province tours

## Multi-City China Tours

- [2-Week Shanghai, Suzhou, Hangzhou, Guilin, Xian, and Beijing Tour](https://www.chinahighlights.com/china-tours/soul-of-chinese-elegance.htm): 14-day multi-city tour covering Beijing, Xi'an, Guilin, Hangzhou, Shanghai
- [14-Day Beijing - Xi'an - Zhangjiajie - Guilin - Shanghai Tour](https://www.chinahighlights.com/china-tours/natural-wonders-discovery.htm): 14-day China tour combining historical sites and natural wonders
- [12-Day Best Yunnan and Zhangjiajie Tour](https://www.chinahighlights.com/china-tours/yunnan-zhangjiajie.htm): 12-day tour of Yunnan, Lijiang, Shangri-La, and Zhangjiajie landscapes
- [The Diverse Minorities – 17-Day Minority Discovery](https://www.chinahighlights.com/china-tours/diverse-minorities.htm): 17-day ethnic minority tour through Guangxi, Guizhou, and Yunnan provinces

## Adventure and Nature Tours

- [5-Day Zhangjiajie Hiking and Biking Tours](https://www.chinahighlights.com/zhangjiajie/tours/outdoor-adventure.htm): 5-day Zhangjiajie adventure with hiking, biking, and Glass Bridge visit
- [2-Day Longji Terraced Fields Hiking Extension](https://www.chinahighlights.com/guilin/tours/longji-terraces-hiking.htm): 2-day Guilin hiking tour through Longji Terraced Fields and Zhuang villages
- [5-Day Sanya Tour — Best Choice for First-Time Visitors](https://www.chinahighlights.com/sanya/tours/beach-tour.htm): 5-day Sanya beach tour featuring Yalong Bay and Nanshan Temple
